_comments: `filter_save_enable` is the key of enable or disable filter usb data save to pcap,
`yes` is enable, `no` disable will save all data
`data_offset` is first filter value position of the usb data
`value` is the data hex value, need add `\x` before hex value
`is_equal` is set filter value equal or not equal usb data in `data_offset` position
